prompt: John F. Kennedy was inaugurated into the presidency quite some time ago. Which song was number 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart on that same day, but 30 years after his inauguration?
answer: Thirty years after JFK’s inauguration—on January 20, 1991—the Billboard Hot 100’s number-one song was **“All the Man That I Need” by Whitney Houston**. (The corresponding Billboard chart is dated January 19, 1991.)
